concerns.text: The implementation relies on hardcoded font paths like `/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf` which are fragile and may not exist on all host systems, causing generation to fall back or fail.
The PR commits generated log files (`backend.log` and `frontend/frontend.log`), which should be kept out of the codebase.

The authentication mechanism in mock login `/auth/login` and Bearer token parsing uses unvalidated credentials and basic colon-split logic without signature verification, which could pose a security risk in a non-mock setup.
